Bill.BriefDescription: Changing membership on the higher education coordinating board.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to membership on the higher education coordinatingboard; amending RCW 28B.80.400; and reenacting and amending RCW28B.80.390.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 28B.80.390 and 2002 c 348 s 1 and 2002 c 129 s 1 areeach reenacted and amended to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: After June 30, 2004, the board shall consist of ten members((, oneof whom shall be a student, who are)) as follows: Seven shall berepresentative of the public, including women and the racial minoritycommunity; one shall be a student; one shall be the superintendent ofpublic instruction; and one shall represent the twoyear system of thestate board for community and technical colleges and be appointed bythe state board for community and technical colleges. ((All)) Thepublic representative and student members shall be appointed at largeby the governor and approved by the senate. Following the term of the chair serving on ((June 13, 2002)) theeffective date of this act, the board shall select from its totalmembership a chair and a vicechair who shall each serve a oneyear p. 1 SB 6129term as chair or vicechair. The chair and vicechair may serve morethan one term if selected to do so by the total membership.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 28B.80.400 and 2002 c 129 s 2 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The members of the board, except ((the chair and)) the studentmember, who are appointed by the governor shall serve for terms of fouryears, the terms expiring on June 30th of the fourth year of the term((except that in the case of initial members, two shall be appointed totwoyear terms, three shall be appointed to threeyear terms, and threeshall be appointed to fouryear terms)). The rest of the members serveterms as follows: (1) The student member shall hold his or her officefor a term of one year from the first day of July; (2) thesuperintendent of public instruction's term shall be concurrent withhis or her term of office; and (3) the member appointed by the stateboard for community and technical colleges shall serve a term of twoyears.
